# Wild Nature Redux
A reimagined edition of [WildNature](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/wildnature) for the WildsRegrown generator.

The mod is made to revisit the best biomes from [WildNature](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/wildnature), it's only playable for Creative builds or screenshots; No survival support.

Recommended settings during world generation: Advanced -> Load -> Wildnature (preset).

If you want to help port the whole of WildNature from 1.18 for survival gameplay feel free to contact on [Discord](https://discord.gg/Kr6veDaJDr).

### Requires:
- [WildsRegrown API](https://modrinth.com/mod/wilds-regrown-api)
- [Vanilla+](https://modrinth.com/mod/wilds-regrown-vanilla+)
